events.notes: CG-18 (Cognition keeper 2026-11-01; built, cognition 2106314; terms? added at f53f16d, unit 3044). Two fields are not typed here because no checker kind fits a map: expectedOutcomes (Categorical over good | bad | unfinished) and terms? (Readonly<Record<string, number>>, host repertoire data, numbers only (cognition src/types.ts): e.g. hours, wage_min; absent when none). Read by the action resolvers, the host's work resolution and Life's LabourSupply provider (IF-27, from the kernel EventBus). t is kernel SimTime (integer ms). status is active | completed | failed | impossible. Kernel 3011 inventory (2026-11-01) confirms the emission at cognition/src/process.ts:65; mind.intention is a quantity, not a second event name.

CG-16/CG-18 (Cognition keeper 2026-11-01; agreed by Reality, Life, Economy and Settlement). One outcome type for every action kind; cause = the intention event id; status completed | failed | impossible (C-Q25 decided by the controller 2026-11-01: a refusal is failed, the reason among the stimuli). Produced by the engine resolving the action kind (shared.action.resolution); consumed through the host's outcome command. stimuli are raw scene truth records; their element schema is not yet fixed (no 3007 kind fits a record), so 'of' is omitted. payload? carries the engine-native record (trade, refused, contact_event) and is not typed here. Settlement (3047) emits it only when hire carries a cause, with stimuli [{post, holder, wage}]. Kernel 3011 inventory (2026-11-01): today emitted by Settlement (src/commands.ts:589, producer settlement.assign.workforce) with payload {cause, status, stimuli, payload}; the harness adapter (kernel/harness/adapters.ts:30) publishes the reducer object but does not forward cause to the kernel envelope, so the envelope cause is missing (REG-31).

RETIRED 2026-11-01 (registry keeper): never emitted under this name; the bus type is postFilled (settlement src/events.ts:4, kernel 3011 inventory); kept as an alias record, do not use. IF-27 (Settlement keeper 2026-11-01, fields confirmed): native event emitted by hire beside shared.action.outcome; cause is the intention event id when hire was asked for by an intention. No engine reads it directly: it travels as the payload of shared.action.outcome, consumed by cognition.learning.outcome (indirect, so consumers stay empty); the pirate host's story bridge ignores it. Built by settlement 3047 (test U24).
